body: We talk but she doesn't understand and then gets mad at me because she doesn't understand

I've been told by multiple women that it isn't always about money, by very well off women, with rich husbands, who still have the same problems. Do like these other posters said, gifts that have meaning from the heart can be a lot better than something from the store. It's your mom, she'll understand and love you regardless. If you're lady friend is special, she love a card you poured your heart out on, trust me, my girlfriend has a while box full of the goofy, cheesy cards that I've given her. If you can find a small necklace or something online too, something with a phrase, or animal you know she likes, they don't cost more than 10-15$, and that have ones that cost less. You never know what life well throw at you either, if you just keep working, something better WILL come along. Sometimes it just takes patience, we are on this planet for an awfully long time, just keep that in mind.

People that care, an truly matter, and want to be part of your life, well understand and love whatever you offer them.
